title: The Clown and the Countryman
author: Aesop (trans. V. S. Vernon Jones)
summary: 乡下人把真猪藏起来，观众却认为小丑的口技更像猪。
publicDomainBasis: Aesop's fables are ancient; this translation by V. S. Vernon Jones was published in 1912. Public domain in the United States and in China.

paragraphs.en: A Nobleman announced his intention of giving a public entertainment in the theatre, and offered splendid prizes to all who had any novelty to exhibit at the performance. The announcement attracted a crowd of conjurers, jugglers, and acrobats, and among the rest a Clown, very popular with the crowd, who let it be known that he was going to give an entirely new turn.
paragraphs.zh: 一位贵族宣布要在剧场举办一场公开表演，并向所有能在演出中展示新奇节目的人提供丰厚奖品。消息引来了一群魔术师、杂耍艺人和杂技演员，其中还有一个很受观众欢迎的小丑，他放出话来说自己要表演一个全新的节目。

paragraphs.en: When the day of the performance came, the theatre was filled from top to bottom some time before the entertainment began. Several performers exhibited their tricks, and then the popular favourite came on empty-handed and alone. At once there was a hush of expectation: and he, letting his head fall upon his breast, imitated the squeak of a pig to such perfection that the audience insisted on his producing the animal, which, they said, he must have somewhere concealed about his person. He, however, convinced them that there was no pig there, and then the applause was deafening.
paragraphs.zh: 演出那天，剧场在开演前很久就座无虚席。几个表演者先展示了各自的绝活，然后这位受欢迎的明星空着手、独自走上台。剧场立刻安静下来，充满期待。他把头垂到胸前，学猪叫学得惟妙惟肖，观众坚持要他交出那头猪，说一定是他藏在身上什么地方了。可他让大家相信，他身上根本没有猪，于是掌声雷动。

paragraphs.en: Among the spectators was a Countryman, who disparaged the Clown's performance and announced that he would give a much superior exhibition of the same trick on the following day. Again the theatre was filled to overflowing, and again the Clown gave his imitation amidst the cheers of the crowd. The Countryman, meanwhile, before going on the stage, had secreted a young porker under his smock; and when the spectators derisively bade him do better if he could, he gave it a pinch in the ear and made it squeal loudly. But they all with one voice shouted out that the Clown's imitation was much more true to life. Thereupon he produced the pig from under his smock and said sarcastically, "There, that shows what sort of judges you are!"
paragraphs.zh: 观众中有个乡下人，贬低小丑的表演，宣称自己第二天要用同样的把戏表演得更胜一筹。剧场再次爆满，小丑又一次在观众的欢呼声中表演了口技。而那乡下人呢，上台前把一只小猪藏在了罩衫底下；当观众嘲弄地叫他“有本事就来个更好的”时，他捏了一下小猪的耳朵，让它大声尖叫。可观众异口同声地喊道，小丑学得才更像真的。于是乡下人从罩衫底下掏出那只猪，讥讽地说：“瞧瞧，这就说明你们是什么水平的评判家！”
